Thank you for contributing to RxJava. Before you create it, please consider these:

- Describe what your contribution is about in English. No need for a verbose explanation disproportional to the impact of the change.
- Make sure you followed the code style of the repository and you have run the `validators` unit tests locally that enforce most of it.
- Make sure your change is accompanied by the relevant unit tests. If you are unsure how to test, indicate it and we'll help you.
- If you are responding to an issue, please include its # number in the commit text: `Resolves #xxxx` or `Related #xxxx`.
- You have to disclose if you used AI to generate the changes. We'd also like you disclosed if you used AI to come up with the fix idea but coded it yourself.
- Please avoid unsolicited pedantic or objectively low effort PRs or anything that would constitute profile propping.
- Do not post fire-and-forget PRs and we will not argue with your AI how to fix the mistakes.
- We are a modern repo, failing to repeatedly heed expected feedbacks will result in a shame + ban.
